statements.status_notes: Debian classifies this as a policy violation rather than a security issue: the visudo temporary-file symlink behavior can only manifest when the sudoers file being edited is in a world-writable directory. sbx-templates ships sudoers files under /etc/sudoers.d, not a world-writable path.
